insight: Open-source; runs music generators like Meta's MusicGen fully offline on-device, with no Python or ML frameworks to install.
name: MusicGPT
tagline: Generate full songs, vocals, and instrumentals from a text prompt.
description: MusicGPT turns a text prompt into a complete, produced song with AI vocals, lyrics, and instrumentation across many genres. Beyond song generation it handles audio tasks like stem extraction, remixing, and a built-in lyrics generator. It runs in the browser and as native iOS and Android apps, with a developer API for programmatic generation. A free plan grants a monthly song quota and credits; non-expiring credit top-ups cover heavier use.
edge: Pairs no-signup free song generation with native iOS/Android apps and a developer API, where most rivals are web-only.
pros: Full songs with vocals and lyrics
Free monthly quota, credits never expire
